title: rosa arvensis var. fastigiata
intro: Rosa arvensis var. fastigiata, commonly known as Field Rose, is a deciduous shrub belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its fragrant flowers and thorny stems. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of nausea, with potential health benefits including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Rosa arvensis var. fastigiata is reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-histaminic, anti-spasmodic, and anti-bacterial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Rosa arvensis var. fastigiata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
